tools.name: comfyui_status
tools.description: Report whether the configured ComfyUI server is reachable and list the workflow ids this plugin exposes.

options.instructions: Use comfyui_status first when a request depends on image generation and you have not yet confirmed that ComfyUI is running. It is a read-only check and reports the exact endpoint.

tools.name: comfyui_list_workflows
tools.description: List the ComfyUI workflow ids configured for this plugin.

options.instructions: Call comfyui_list_workflows before comfyui_run_workflow so you use a configured workflow id rather than guessing one.

tools.name: comfyui_run_workflow
tools.description: Queue one configured ComfyUI workflow, wait for it to finish and return the produced image references. Override node inputs with '<node id>.<input name>' keys.

workflow.description: A workflow id returned by comfyui_list_workflows.

inputs.description: Optional node input overrides keyed '<node id>.<input name>', for example {"6.text": "a quiet harbour"}.

options.instructions: comfyui_run_workflow queues real work on the user's ComfyUI server and can consume GPU time. Use a configured workflow id, pass only the inputs you must change, and report the returned image references. If ComfyUI is unreachable the call returns an error explaining the endpoint; tell the user instead of retrying blindly.
